title: Retrospective mortality risk stratification in critically ill patients with documented hypoferremia analysis code and aggregate outputs
description: R3 reporting-correction branch-review candidate based on computation archive v1.2.2 (10.5281/zenodo.21772246), awaiting maintainer review and a new versioned release. Documentation and AUROC intervals are synchronized to unchanged canonical functions: DeLong internally and class-stratified percentile bootstrap with 2000 resamples and seed 42 for temporal/exploratory cohorts. Primary models were not retrained and their predictions, AUROC point estimates and Brier scores are unchanged. Only the pre-existing NIV-exclusion sensitivity was refitted for verification; all four rows reproduce its canonical aggregate reference and resolve inherited manuscript reporting differences. No new patch version or DOI has been assigned. After review, the maintainer must assign the actual next version and archive the exact approved commit. Patient-level data, identifiers, outcomes, individual probabilities, cohort-ID lists, and fitted preprocessing or model objects are not redistributed.
